title: Gentian app chart values
description: Rung L0 of the customization ladder. Publishing this schema is what makes configuration discoverable and machine-checkable: a typo fails at install time instead of at pod start, and an agent can find out whether a requested change is already a supported knob. See gentian-os/docs/app-customization.md.

fullnameOverride.description: Pins the name every object derives from. A ComponentProfile routes to Services by name, so the profile sets this in extraValues and names its backends <fullnameOverride>-api and -web.

existingSecret.description: Pattern A: the chart consumes a Secret created by ExternalSecret. Credentials are never chart values.

disabled.description: Local development only. The backend refuses to start with this true in production.

mode.description: pkce: the bundle runs the code flow. edge: the platform's Gateway holds the session and forwards the zone's token; the bundle holds nothing.

issuer.description: The issuer the forwarded token is verified against. The operator sets it under edge.

clientId.description: The client whose tokens the API accepts: the zone's under edge.

audience.description: The audience the forwarded token must carry under edge: the director's.

platform.description: Facts of the cluster this component runs in, set by the operator from the profile's valueMapping.platform. Not chosen here.

director.description: Where the director answers, for a platform-trust component that relays the caller's token to it.

dropIns.description: Rung L1. Config fragments mounted into the app's conf.d directory and merged in lexicographic order. Prefixes 00-49 are platform, 50-89 profile, 90-99 tenant.

mountPath.description: Absolute path; must match the AppProfile's declared dropIns[].path.

configMaps.description: ConfigMaps to project into the drop-in directory, lowest precedence first.

files.description: Inline fragments shipped with the chart (50-89 prefixes).

extensions.description: Rung L3. Plugins are baked into the image; this only controls discovery.

tag.description: Pinned; never 'latest' for a released chart.
